scope: Four user references plus all 25 entries from each of the artist’s Art for Publication and Neo-Folk Primitive galleries, as retrieved. This is not a complete career archive.
reading_rule: Portfolio context is artist supplied; interpretations are explicitly inferred. Exact article titles and publication dates remain unverified unless stated.

artworks.title: Brain and skeleton
artworks.source_status: user reference; attribution and original commission not independently matched
artworks.observed_forms: Brain and skeletal forms occupy a frontal figure; hands sit beside its head; stars and planets surround it.
artworks.interpretation: The image combines a person’s internal anatomy with a cosmic setting. Without its original context, an intended claim about consciousness, medicine, or spirituality cannot be assigned.
artworks.interpretation_status: inferred from visible forms and available context
